basic_profile.bio: Avid Detroit Red Wings fan and fantasy hockey enthusiast. Born and raised in the Detroit area, I have been following the team since childhood. My interests include hockey analytics, crafting the perfect fantasy team, and exploring new technologies in vaping. Dislikes include missing a game due to work commitments and the off-season lull. Currently living in Ann Arbor, I work as a data analyst for a tech startup. I am single and typically online during late evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in statistics and data analysis, I've honed my skills through both formal education and hands-on experience in the tech industry. My expertise in hockey analytics is largely self-taught, driven by a passion for the sport and a desire to optimize my fantasy league performance.
